rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or one of the Minor Core courses (e.g., JEWISHST 77, JEWISHST 115, or JEWISHST 117, depending on annual course offerings) before they can declare the minor in Jewish Studies.
Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.

rules.name: Minor Core Courses
rules.notes: Consult with the Associate Director of Jewish Studies to confirm which active courses fulfill the Minor Core course requirement.

rules.name: Jewish Studies Electives

children.name: AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or NATIVEAM courses (up to 5 units)
Petitioned courses (up to 5 units) and external credit (up to 10 units)

rules.desc:
Jewish Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Jewish Studies, with the exception below.
Jewish Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree in Jewish Studies.

grading: A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core. Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units.
policies: No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives in the Jewish Studies minor. Students who wish to petition a course must fill out and submit a course petition form for the CCSRE Academic Programs team to review within one month of completing their annual degree audit meeting with the CCSRE Student Services Officer.
transferPolicy: Up to ten units of external credit may be applied toward elective coursework in the minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks the 30 units: CSRE 100 and one Minor Core course (JEWISHST 77, 115 or 117), each letter graded with a C- or better, and electives from JEWISHST courses plus up to 5 units of AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or NATIVEAM courses, passed with a D- or better. Checked by hand: petitioned courses (up to 5 units), external credit (up to 10 units) and that no more than one class is taken S/NC.
